text:
Maya: quick heads-up — planning a small change to trace sampling in the otel-collector config at 15:00 PT today. This will increase app-level sampling from 20% -> 50% for user-facing services to improve tail trace coverage. Expect a bump in spans and tracing dashboard traffic for ~10–20m.

Devon: thanks — is this a canary or full rollout? any fallback?

Maya: canary first — 5% traffic for 10m, then 25% for 15m, then full. fallback is immediate config revert + restart of collector DaemonSet. rollback playbook: `kubectl -n infra rollout undo ds/otel-collector` (tested in staging).

Priya: can you drop the PR link? I'll take a quick review now.

Maya: PR: https://git.redwood/infra/otel/merge/2345 (small diff, sampling.rate -> 0.5). Also note one dashboard panel will show a ~2x increase in trace count — will update panel title to include "(sampling change)" so people know the spike is expected.

Samir: I'll own traces smoke: watch "trace-latency-p95" and the root-cause waterfall for any unexpected latency regressions. Will run tail sampling queries in Honeycomb: `trace.duration.p95 service:web` and the latency heatmap.

Lina: I'll handle alerts — planning to temporarily raise the trace-error-rate alert from 1% -> 2% threshold for the next 30m during rollout to avoid noise. Also will mute `trace-volume-increase` for the rollout window. Can you confirm which alert rules touch these metrics?

Maya: alert names: `infra:trace:error-rate`, `infra:trace:volume-spike`. I'll paste the exact alert IDs in a sec.

Maya: alert IDs: `alerts/7321` (error-rate), `alerts/7322` (volume-spike). Lina: feel free to mute `alerts/7322` from 14:55–15:30.

Devon: pinging @oncall — can you be available for 15:00–15:30 in case we need to roll back?

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by Maya for 15:00 PT — otel-collector config update (canary 5%). ETA 15m per stage.

oncall (Priya): I can be on standby 15:00–15:45.

Samir: quick checklist I will run at canary start: 1) confirm canary ingest rate in traces dashboard 2) check p95 latency for web/auth 3) run 5 synthetic user traces via `make smoke-trace` 4) verify no increase in 5xx errors in logs.

Maya: docs/checklist I'm using: `# preflight`
```
- create canary rollout: patch sampler to 0.5 for 5% of pods
- wait 10m, monitor panels: traces/count, traces/p95, trace-errors
- escalate if trace-errors > 1.5% OR p95 increases > 30% vs baseline
- if escalate: rollback with `kubectl -n infra rollout undo ds/otel-collector`
```

Priya: PR approved with one nit (commented). Will merge when you give the go.

Lina: I've set a temporary mute on alerts/7322 14:55–15:35 and bumped threshold on alerts/7321 to 2% for the same window. Will unmute/restore after 15:40 unless we call otherwise.

Maya: merging at 14:50. starting canary at 15:00 as planned. I'll post status updates here during the rollout.

deploy-bot: Merge complete (PR 2345) by Priya at 14:51 PT. Canary rollout started at 15:00 PT (5%).

Maya: canary looks healthy at 15:10 — trace count +180%, p95 web +5% (within expected). moving to 25% now.

Samir: running smoke traces now, all clear. no 5xx spikes.

Maya: full rollout completed at 15:28. Lina — did mute/unmute go fine?

Lina: unmuted alerts at 15:42, restored thresholds. No pager noise observed.

Devon: nice — thanks team. I'll add a short note in the deploy log about sampling increase so SREs expect the metric change.

Maya: thanks everyone :tada: will follow up with a small dashboard annotation and a short post in #eng-runtime about the change.
